name: Reprojection with Temporal Accumulation
definition: A technique to stabilize voxel rendering over time by blending the current frame's color with the accumulated color from the previous frame, using camera motion vectors to align pixels.
summary: Reprojection with Temporal Accumulation stabilizes voxel rendering by blending current frames with previous history using motion vectors, differing from other methods by operating in image space to reduce noise rather than accelerating ray traversal.
